correctness.rationale: Spectral decomposition of the star Laplacian into constants, radial line eigenvalue m+1, and leaf fluctuations eigenvalue 1 gives the exact matrix T_{s,m}(c,x)=x-E_mx+a(E_mx-c), a=(m+1)^(-s). Direct column sums, row sums and singular values yield the advertised 1, infinity, and 2 endpoint norms and the exact hub/leaf crossover a=2/(m+2). Independent eigendecomposition and matrix norm tests at m=2,3,7,16 and s=.2,.5,1,1.7 agree. For fixed 1<=p<infty, decomposition into bounded I-E_m plus hub mass of norm m^{1/p}a proves s<1/p and s>1/p regimes; step-function embedding proves critical D_p. For non-Hilbert p, a two-valued extremizer of the known sharp centering norm C_p has nonzero derivative in scalar c while the input denominator changes by o(|c|), giving strict D_p>C_p. P=1,2 endpoints handled separately. This is an analytic proof, not an inference from finite numerical checks.
